purpose: Govern how Sheikha performs installation, development, programming, review, verification, reporting, commit, push, PR handling, and merge preparation.

developmentLifecycle.name: workspace_intake
developmentLifecycle.rule: Read current branch, git status, active instructions, and relevant files before editing.

developmentLifecycle.name: context_analysis
developmentLifecycle.rule: Analyze existing architecture, ownership, Fabric routes, governance files, and prior decisions.

developmentLifecycle.name: implementation_plan
developmentLifecycle.rule: Use the smallest safe implementation path that preserves the active freeze and governance baseline.

developmentLifecycle.name: governed_programming
developmentLifecycle.rule: Edit only scoped files, avoid unrelated refactors, and preserve user work.

developmentLifecycle.name: verification
developmentLifecycle.rule: Run syntax checks, JSON validation, lint, targeted tests, and endpoint checks when relevant.

developmentLifecycle.name: documentation_and_indexing
developmentLifecycle.rule: Document new governance surfaces with stable IDs, file paths, purpose, and decisions.

developmentLifecycle.name: commit_governance
developmentLifecycle.rule: Commit only scoped, verified changes with a clear governance message.

developmentLifecycle.name: push_governance
developmentLifecycle.rule: Push only after verification and successful governance hooks.

developmentLifecycle.name: post_activation_report
developmentLifecycle.rule: Report what changed, what was verified, what remains blocked, and what requires human approval.
